new_ops.name: two_stream_rel_attn

inputs.name: x
inputs.meaning: content stream h^(m-1) (query stream g^(m-1) processed with shared parameters)

new_ops.reason: Needs a Transformer-XL relative-position attention primitive (relative positional encodings plus per-head relative segment bias a_ij=(q_i+b)^T s_ij), with keys/values over [cached memory, current segment], a permutation-order attention mask (content stream sees z_<=t, query stream sees z_<t), and two streams g and h sharing parameters. None of this is expressible with the exact causal attention op.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Query stream initialised with a trainable vector w, run alongside the content stream through every layer with shared parameters; dropped at finetuning
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: Computationally, the first layer query stream is initialized with a trainable vector, i.e. $g_i^{(0)} = w$, while the content stream is set to the corresponding word embedding, i.e. $h_i^{(0)} = e(x_i)$.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Segment recurrence memory: cached per-layer content representations from the previous segment are concatenated into keys/values
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: Then, based on the permutation $\tilde{\rvz}$, we process the first segment, and then cache the obtained content representations $\tilde{\rvh}^{(m)}$ for each layer $m$.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Relative segment encodings: learned per-head s_+ / s_- and bias b added to attention scores
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: When $i$ attends to $j$, the segment encoding $\mathbf{s}_{ij}$ is used to compute an attention weight $a_{ij} = (\mb{q}_i + \mb{b})^\top \mb{s}_{ij}$, where $\mb{q}_i$ is the query vector as in a standard attention operation and $\mb{b}$ is a learnable head-specific bias vector.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Permutation of factorization order realised through attention masks, with positional encodings kept on the original order
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: In other words, we keep the original sequence order, use the positional encodings corresponding to the original sequence, and rely on a proper attention mask in Transformers to achieve permutation of the factorization order.

output.notes: Described XLNet-Large, the only configuration whose sizes are stated (Table tab:hp-pretrain). XLNet-Base (ablations) is said to use the same hyperparameters as BERT-Base, but no values are restated, so it is omitted. The paper says only 'GeLU', so the erf/tanh form is left unspecified. Vocab size, LayerNorm eps, biases, the relative-position encoding details (inherited from Transformer-XL but not restated) and memory length are not stated. The FFN structure (up/GeLU/down) is assumed from 'PosFF' and the 'FFN inner hidden size' entry. The attention output projection is folded into the unsupported attention op.
